tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the board lanes, the content behind panels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Bars, cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill, table headers, code blocks, the second neutral layer.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Progress track, skeleton lines, pressed fill on neutral controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-2 and surface-3. Also the current nav rule and pressed toggles.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-2: 5.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: card edges, lane rules, table rows. It sits near 1.4:1, so it never marks a control.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Addition. Border of inputs, selects, checkboxes and quiet buttons: 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Heat. The one primary action of a view and whatever waits for the human; nothing else. Text on surface and bg at 5.1:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: heat-tint
tokens.usage: Addition. Fill behind accent text: the hot pulse cell, an armed approval, text selection.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done and healthy: progress fill, live dot, passed verifier. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Stale data, unstable connection, search highlight base. Text on surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failure and blocked: offline, failed run, blocked task reason. Text on surface, bg and bad-tint.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Addition. Fill of the connection banner and of error notices, under bad text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text links in running prose and informational events.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: solid, 3:1 or better on every surface. Never removed, never the accent.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral tag fill.

tokens.name: chip-ink
tokens.usage: Text on chip-bg.

tokens.name: stage-captured
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for captured. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-ready
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for ready. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-approved
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for approved. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-executing
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for executing. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-blocked
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for blocked. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-review
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for review. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-archived
tokens.usage: Stage mark and lane rule for archived. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: stage-captured-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the captured stage chip.

tokens.name: stage-captured-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-captured-bg.

tokens.name: stage-ready-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the ready stage chip.

tokens.name: stage-ready-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-ready-bg.

tokens.name: stage-approved-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the approved stage chip and of done epic items.

tokens.name: stage-approved-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-approved-bg.

tokens.name: stage-executing-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the executing stage chip and of the read-only banner.

tokens.name: stage-executing-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-executing-bg.

tokens.name: stage-blocked-bg
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the blocked stage chip: the one stage chip that is not a tint.

tokens.name: stage-blocked-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-blocked-bg.

tokens.name: stage-review-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the review stage chip.

tokens.name: stage-review-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-review-bg.

tokens.name: stage-archived-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the archived stage chip.

tokens.name: stage-archived-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage-archived-bg: the lowest stage pair, 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: person-1-bg

tokens.name: person-1-ink
tokens.usage: Addition. Initials on person-1-bg.

tokens.name: person-2-bg
tokens.usage: Addition. Fill of a person's badge (rose). Tells people apart and carries no state.

tokens.name: person-2-ink
tokens.usage: Addition. Initials on person-2-bg.

tokens.usage: Addition. Fill of a person's badge (olive). Tells people apart and carries no state.

tokens.name: person-3-ink
tokens.usage: Addition. Initials on person-3-bg.
